rfdetr_L.method: ScoreCalibrator.fit on per-image max score of 1158 sdis-val negatives (reports/v3/eval_rfdetrL_e48_val.raw.parquet); arm D used the 90th/80th percentile of the same values as thr10/thr20

analysis_params.keep_rule: image kept only if >=1 pseudo box; no_smoke clip frames and D-Fire fire-only images without a box are EXCLUDED

stage_reuse.note: D3 re-uses the arm-B stage for unchanged FireMan/Sheffield (B_v1 pod root) and the D3_src stage (teacher job) for the pseudo-boxed images; D3_v1.tar holds labels/lists/yamls + relative symlinks

d3.rule: D2 rules without GT filter (no author boxes exist): (a) FUSED calibrated WBF >= 0.9918 (accurate_recipe fp0.10); (b) SINGLE teacher calibrated >= 0.98 (2% neg-FP; raw {"dino_b4_lora_L": 0.9962, "dino_b6_lora_Hplus": 0.9963, "rfdetr_L": 0.8958}); (c) AGREE >=2 teachers IoU>=0.5 each calibrated >= 0.80; fused > single > agree, dedup IoU>=0.3. Image kept ONLY if >=1 pseudo box (no teacher-silence negatives from unlabelled footage); the karkkila no_smoke clip is scored for the FP statistic but never trained; D-Fire fire-only images without a box are excluded.

rfdetr_L.method: ScoreCalibrator.fit on per-image max score of 1158 sdis-val negatives (reports/v3/eval_rfdetrL_e48_val.raw.parquet); arm D used the 90th/80th percentile of the same values as thr10/thr20

d3.weighting: D3 images x1; all B components keep B multiplicities and B files (E baked, Boreal E_ET_v1, FireMan/Sheffield at the B_v1 pod root)

label_type_note: author = dataset annotations (not our human review); masked = author labels unchanged + pixels of teacher-agreed unlabelled regions replaced by image mean; model-assisted = teacher pseudo boxes
